purpose: Integrate the controlled fixture admission stage into the authoritative property fixture revalidation control chain so the next actionable gate is visible in one place.

next_action.required_action: Submit an actual controlled fixture candidate for admission review.

state_transition_rules: NOT_SUBMITTED -> PROPOSED only when an actual candidate fixture is submitted.
PROPOSED -> APPROVAL_PENDING only after required provenance/privacy/meaning checks are completed.
APPROVAL_PENDING -> APPROVED only when the admission gate conditions pass.
No admission state may be inferred from validation of the contract itself.
No dependent revalidation may execute before APPROVED.
guardrails: Synthetic or source-derived fixture status remains explicit.
No live official property record is claimed.
